claims.text: The driver's own trace puts his longest unbroken stay inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at 170 seconds — 130 seconds short of the 300-second minimum POL-NS-01(c) requires — because he left the radius at 19:02:50 and did not return until 19:03:50. A 170-second hold does not satisfy limb (c), and the pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone whose minimum is 300 seconds.

The only way the driver reaches 300 seconds is by adding the two separated intervals together under POL-NS-06(i), and the rider's claim is precisely that they cannot be added. Limb (i) governs how the shortfall computation in POL-NS-06 is performed; it is not a licence to treat two holds broken by a one-minute absence from the arrival radius as the single continuous hold POL-NS-01(c) demands. On the rider's construction the effective continuous dwell is 170 seconds, not the 330 seconds the derived accumulated figure reports, the 60-second excursion being time the driver was not holding position.

On that construction the shortfall is 130 seconds (170 measured against 300 required), POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee not chargeable, and the fare record — SGD 4.00 charged, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, payment_status CHARGED — must be reversed in full. The rider is the filing party, so a full reversal of the contested SGD 4.00 is the remedy.

POL-NS-06 turns on the driver's dwell, not on the rider: its terms apply 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. The rider's device position during the wait is therefore not an element of the shortfall test, and it cannot be used to shore up a fee that the dwell evidence defeats on its own.

The trip record's wait_time_min of 6.2 minutes is wall-clock measured from the arrival marker and includes the interval in which the trace places the driver outside the arrival radius. It is not the in-geofence hold that POL-NS-01(c) measures from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and it cannot be used to make up the 130-second gap.

claims.text: The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-07T19:00:20+08:00, which is POL-NS-01 limb (a), the first of the four conditions the driver must carry. The trip terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so this is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE trip that would fall to POL-NS-03.

The driver was inside the arrival geofence at and before the arrival marker. The pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, and the driver's whole track sits between 26.0 m and 179.8 m of the pin with a mean of 46.1 m. The first GPS fix is at 19:00:00, twenty seconds before the 19:00:20 arrival event, and the dwell_start_offset_sec confirms the waiting clock began on GPS entry into the fence, exactly as POL-NS-01 limb (b) and POL-NS-02 require. Limb (b) is satisfied.

The rider's theory of the case is that the two separate in-geofence intervals may not be summed because the car left the bay. That is answered directly by POL-NS-06(i), which permits separate in-geofence intervals within a single pickup attempt to be accumulated. The computation records the limb as available: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated with type CLOSURE, its geometry (lat 1.2997-1.3037, lng 103.8377-103.8417) covers the pickup road at Orchard Central marked ride-hail bay, and its active window 18:50-19:30 covers the waiting period 19:00-19:06:30. Holding position was not lawfully possible, and the driver's furthest point between the intervals was 179.8 m, comfortably inside the 300.0 m leash. The rider's ground for refusing to sum the intervals therefore fails on the policy's own terms.

On the accumulated basis the driver met the minimum dwell for this zone class. The two in-geofence runs are 170 seconds (19:00:00-19:02:50) and 160 seconds (19:03:50-19:06:30), for an accumulated dwell of 330.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, a surplus of 30 seconds (shortfall_sec -30.0). POL-NS-06(ii) does not bite because cumulative dwell does not fall short; limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied.

The final limb is met: the trip record shows no boarding event and shows the trip terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, at 19:06:30, after the required dwell had elapsed. That is POL-NS-01 limb (d). All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold.

There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. At the arrival timestamp the driver was inside the 120 m arrival radius, not more than 300 m from the pin, and the track never exceeds 179.8 m from the pin at any point in the trip, so the distance trigger cannot fire. The arrival marker stands and the waiting clock correctly ran from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:00:00.

POL-NS-04, the rider's unanswered-contact clause, is unavailable on this record. Limb (a) requires at least one rider message during the waiting window that is locating or coordinating. The chat log holds three messages and not one of them is from the rider: MSG-09107-001 is a SYSTEM arrival notice, and MSG-09107-002 and MSG-09107-003 are the driver's own. With limb (a) failed at the threshold, the clause does not apply and cannot exonerated the rider.

The GPS rider track affirmatively places the rider nowhere near the pickup. Across 19 rider fixes spanning 19:00:30 to 19:06:30 the rider's distance from the pin is a constant 519.4 m, far outside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m for LARGE_VENUE, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0. This is direct evidence that the rider was not at the bay during the waiting period, and it independently disposes of any route to POL-NS-04 limb (c), which the rider would need for that clause even if limb (a) had held.

The fee line reconciles with the schedule, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) and no basis to disturb the charge. The fare breakdown items a cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 for a LARGE_VENUE pickup and a RYDE_X vehicle; the zone-class fee is SGD 4.00 and the vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, and POL-NS-01's resolution rule takes the GREATER of the two, which is SGD 4.00. The amount charged matches, and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0.

The driver is owed compensation under POL-NS-07. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver receives 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, SGD 3.20, the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: it requires BOTH a count of 4 or more and a rate above 0.08, and driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, so the first limb fails outright. Compensation is payable, and the ruling on the fee is that the charge stands.

ruling.explanation:
This dispute is over the SGD 4.00 no-show fee charged on trip TRP-09107. The fee stands — the rider's claim is not supported — and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of compensation, which is platform-funded and is NOT recovered from the rider.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The driver tapped 'arrived' at Orchard Central marked ride-hail bay at 19:00:20 and the trace places him in position from 19:00:00, twenty seconds earlier. He held for 170 seconds (19:00:00–19:02:50), then circulated for about one minute (peak 179.8 m from the pin), returned to the same bay at 19:03:50, held a further 160 seconds (to 19:06:30), and then terminated the trip with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The rider's device sat a constant 519 m from the pin across the whole waiting window, and the chat log contains no rider message.

THE RIDER'S CASE — the two waits may not be summed. This is rejected. POL-NS-06(i) expressly permits separate in-geofence intervals within a single pickup attempt to be accumulated where (1) the driver never travels more than 300 m from the pin, and (2) a traffic advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the waiting period carries a qualifying type. All conditions hold here: the furthest point between the intervals was 179.8 m, inside the 300 m leash, and EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated with type CLOSURE, its geometry covers the Orchard Central bay and its window (18:50–19:30) covers the wait (19:00–19:06:30). Holding position was not lawfully possible, so the one-minute circulation was compliance with the closure, not abandonment of the pickup. The effective in-geofence dwell is therefore 330 seconds against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum — a 30-second surplus — and limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied. The policy's own summation rule, not a construction of it, answers the continuity point.

THE RIDER'S OTHER POINTS. The observation that POL-NS-06 turns on the driver's dwell and applies 'whether or not the rider was present' is correct as a statement of the clause, and is accepted — it simply does not help here, because the dwell computation on the policy's terms comes out sufficient. The characterisation of trip_record.wait_time_min (6.2 minutes) as wall-clock time from the arrival marker rather than an in-geofence hold is also correct, and the ruling does not use it; it rests on the derived in-geofence figures.

THE DRIVER'S CASE. Limbs (a), (b) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are made out: an 'arrived' event exists, qualifying in-geofence fixes precede it, and the trip shows no boarding and a driver termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW at a time after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-05 does not bite: at the arrival marker the driver was inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE radius and the track never exceeded 179.8 m, so there is no false arrival and the waiting clock correctly ran from the first qualifying fix. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails at the threshold because not one of the three chat messages is from the rider (one is the SYSTEM arrival notice, two are the driver's own), so the clause is unavailable regardless of the rider's position. POL-NS-03 does not apply, as the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue. POL-NS-08 discloses no defect: the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the schedule for a LARGE_VENUE zone (SGD 4.00) and a RYDE_X tier (SGD 4.00), whose GREATER is SGD 4.00, and there is no clock skew, trace gap or chat truncation.

COMPENSATION. With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 gives the driver 80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, i.e. SGD 3.20, with 20% retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the required 4) and the ratio to completed_trips_30d is far below 0.08, so the first limb fails outright and no escalation packet is produced. All artifacts relied on carry weight_multiplier 1.0, so no discount applies to this ruling and no referral is generated.
